about.title: About us
about.description1: Our site is an open registry for tenants and landlords, created to increase transparency and reliability in the rental market for housing and commercial real estate. We collect and systematically organize data on complaints, court decisions and reviews, so that each party to the transaction can make more informed decisions.
about.description2: Our goal is to reduce the number of conflict situations and create a safe space for rental. We provide convenient search tools so that you can quickly check the honesty of a tenant or landlord.

features.title: Our Services
features.subtitle: Choose the service you need to work with our platform
features.registry_description: Avoid bad tenants and landlords with complaints and bad reviews by checking their history.
features.maps_description: Browse available apartments for rent in your desired area in real-time. View property ratings for easy and quick selection.
features.help_description: Have questions? Then go to the frequently asked questions page and get answers to your questions.

section1.title: 1. Accuracy of Published Information
section1.description: Each user is obligated to publish only truthful, verified information.

prohibited.title: What is prohibited:
items: Deliberate distortion of facts, falsification of complaints or events.
Posting complaints on behalf of third parties without their written consent.
Using false documents or forged materials (screenshots, photos, contracts, etc.).

allowed.title: What is allowed:
items: Complaints supported by facts, contracts, photo/video evidence, correspondence.
Posting reviews about personal experiences with the tenant.

sanctions.title: Sanctions:
sanctions.description: Warning → 30-day account suspension → permanent ban for repeated violations. In case of severe violations — permanent ban.

section2.title: 2. Confidentiality and Protection of Personal Data

prohibited.title: What is prohibited:
items: Disclosure of passport data, scans of identification documents, and other confidential data without justification.
Posting data of third parties without their participation in the rental contract.
Using user data for harassment, manipulation, or threats.

allowed.title: What is allowed:
items: Indicating the full name, phone number, and ID number of the tenant within the complaint with the rental contract.
Using edited documents without disclosing personal data.

sanctions.title: Sanctions:
sanctions.description: Warning → Deletion of post → Temporary suspension → Possible data transfer to authorized authorities.

allowed.title: What is encouraged:
items: Constructive criticism and objective presentation of facts.

sanctions.title: Sanctions:
sanctions.description: Warning → Temporary comment restriction → Account suspension.

section4.title: 4. Hate Speech and Discrimination
section4.description: Racism, sexism, xenophobia, and other forms of intolerance are strictly prohibited.

section5.title: 5. Prohibition of Advertising, Spam, and Self-Promotion

allowed.title: Exceptions:
items: Recommendations from lawyers and partner organizations in special sections.

sanctions.title: Sanctions:
sanctions.description: Post deletion → Temporary ban → Permanent ban.

section6.title: 6. Creation and Use of Fake Accounts
section6.description: Creating multiple accounts for manipulation and using other people's data is prohibited.

sanctions.title: Sanctions:
sanctions.description: Immediate ban of all associated accounts.

section7.title: 7. Using the Site for Illegal Purposes
section7.description: Using the platform for extortion, threats, and falsifying evidence is prohibited.

sanctions.title: Sanctions:
sanctions.description: Immediate ban and data transfer to law enforcement authorities.

section8.title: 8. Contesting Reviews and Complaints
section8.description: Anyone can request a review of a complaint. Moderation is obligated to ensure the transparency of the review process.

section9.title: 9. Respect for the Work of Administration and Moderation

section10.title: 10. Updating and Compliance with the Rules
section10.description: Users automatically agree to the rules upon registration. Rules may be changed without notification.
